messages:
anya (PM): Need a tiny, testable gating matrix for a regional-affinity cutover pilot. Keep it minimal for legal.

sam (Eng): propose flow: sandbox smoke -> 1-tenant staging canary -> 5% prod for 8h -> 25% -> full. Each step has a 4h observation window.

lee (Arch): add a hard block: if KV miss > 12% and cold-start p95 > 2x baseline, stop rollout. Also require fallback routing precedence.

rachel (SRE): ops minimal checklist before staging:
- alerts: region.failover.init, tenant.p99.spike
- smoke harness hitting top-15 prompts every 15m
- chaos micro-test in staging (egress drop) with one internal tenant
Fail any -> rollback.

jon (Sales): customer wants 30s failover in contract. real?

sam (Eng): routing switch can be initiated <60s; cache-dependent perf restoration typically 2-10 minutes. suggest contract phrasing: "automated routing switch within 60s; expected full performance within 10 minutes under normal load".

anya (PM): good. draft launch thresholds for pilot: p99 <= 180ms regional, error rate < 0.5%, route-init < 60s, cache hit > 85% after 10m, no top-10 prompt regressions.

lee (Arch): add policy: if tenant p99 > 250ms for 5m, auto-move to isolated lane with a 15m grace to prevent thrash.

anya (PM): action items: @sam open routing-policy PR with canary hooks; @rachel write runbook + chaos plan; @lee draft isolation policy; @jon confirm contract wording. I'll consolidate gating matrix.

ops-bot: Created ticket ARCH-2125: regional-affinity-cutover-pilot. Owners: sam, rachel, lee, anya. ETA: 2025-08-05.

jon (Sales): noted, will push legal. :thumbsup:

anya (PM): thanks everyone, will publish draft by EOD.
